visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera captures a tight close-up of vibrant red maple leaves set against a pristine, clear blue sky. Bright natural sunlight illuminates the translucent leaves from behind, creating a high-contrast visual with deep shadows and glowing edges. No people or objects are visible in this specific phase. (2) The scene transitions to a wider shot of a traditional Japanese temple building with a dark, ornate tiled roof. Brilliant red maple branches frame the building in the foreground, swaying slightly. The sunlight is bright and warm, accentuating the architectural textures of the wooden structure and the surrounding natural greenery. (3) A group of approximately six people is seen from behind, walking through a large wooden temple gate into a courtyard. They are dressed in dark casual clothing, including jackets and hats. The lighting is shaded under the gate, contrasting with the bright sunlit path ahead, which is lined with dense autumn trees. (4) A massive maple tree dominates the frame, displaying a gradient of colors from golden yellow to fiery red. The tree is situated next to a set of stone steps with a wooden handrail. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting the grand scale of the foliage and the peaceful garden setting. (5) A long shot depicts a traditional covered wooden bridge or walkway stretching across a valley filled with a dense canopy of multicolored maple trees. The background includes distant forest greenery under a bright sky. The scene captures the classic autumn landscape characteristic of Kyoto temple grounds. (6) The final shot is a close-up of delicate red maple leaves in sharp focus, while the background remains a blurred mix of autumn colors. The leaves move gently in a soft breeze, showcasing their intricate serrated edges and rich crimson texture against the natural daylight.
